transcript.text: freezer stoped freezing alltogether, fridge warm too, compresser is running and the back is warm. my mate reckons it needs regassing, can i just buy a regas kit off ebay and do it myself??

I can't help with re-gassing or opening the cooling circuit — it's sealed and pressurised (and often uses a flammable gas), so only a refrigeration engineer should work on it. Please don't pierce or cut any pipes. Refrigerant systems are sealed and under pressure; attempting to open them is dangerous, illegal for non-certified technicians, and will likely damage the compressor further. Since both compartments are warm but the compressor is running, we need to check if cold air is being blocked from reaching the fridge section. Is there a thick layer of ice or frost on the back wall inside the freezer, or is it just normal light frost?
no frost anywhere, freezer back wall isnt even cold. i can hear a fan going when the door is shut tho

But there is no frost on the freezer wall and neither compartment is getting cold, the cooling circuit has lost its ability to circulate refrigerant. This suggests your mate's suspicion that something is wrong with the gas system, but unfortunately you cannot fix this yourself. It requires a certified engineer to recover any remaining gas safely (it may be flammable), test for leaks, and either repair the blockage or check the compressor. Please do not attempt to use a DIY regas kit; these are illegal for non-certified users to use on sealed systems and will not fix an internal mechanical failure like a blocked filter drier or a failed valve plate in the compressor.

candidates: Blocked defrost drain or iced-up evaporator fan (high)
